mode: verify-only extra same-context original/candidate/original raster calls
scope: At each original already-selected pose, reuse original this and arguments/time. No extra Game ticks, selection, clip advancement or freezing/mutation of the supplied pose object.
body: Original pre-weapon bodyCanvas clear/draw remains before armed GL in every call. Compare full original 256x256 RGBA body and colour arrays, frame bounds/core/contour and metadata across AB/AA/BA at zero tolerance.
state: Extra quality calls end with original A2 result; extra GL draws and fullRGBA reads are bounded diagnostic overhead, not cost evidence. Body context/colour context/nativeAPI, model visibility, raster arguments and static source provenance must remain original.
exceptionLimit: Deferring a native getImageData failure changes how much drawing preceded the throw. Original thrown values are preserved and no candidate retry occurs, but universal exceptional side-effect ordering is not certified. Direct/verify or method replacements must use original path and block acceptance.
independence: Same-context quality cannot erase unresolved cross-context wholeCanvas AA/AB/BA failures. Existing strict wholeCanvas gate, old raw failures and current cost run remain separate.
costMode: No verification, same original two GL draws and one fullRGBA body read per raster. Installer reporting and guards included in callbacks. Predeclared start.json gates unchanged. Single fresh A/B/A bracket; shared URL and driver caches remain resident.
dataPreservation: No source model/rig/clip/texture/geometry/UV/moodboard/save/user8806/IAB mutation, no new paid requests, no publication.
